unit_attributes.statement: A generator may accumulate as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste and either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code in containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, without a permit or permit by rule and without complying with the requirements of Chapters 3745-50, 3745-54 to 3745-57 and 3745-205, 3745-65 to 3745-69 and 3745-256, 3745-266, and 3745-267 of the Administrative Code, provided that all of the conditions for exemption in rule 3745-52-15 are met.

A generator may comply with the conditions for exemption in rule 3745-52-15 instead of complying with the conditions for exemption in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of rule 3745-52-15.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, if a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, the generator shall immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, the generator shall use a container made of or lined with materials that will not react with, and are otherwise compatible with, the hazardous waste to be accumulated, so that the ability of the container to contain the waste is not impaired.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials, shall not be placed in the same container, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, hazardous waste shall not be placed in an unwashed container that previously held an incompatible waste or material, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, a container holding a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers shall be separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, a container holding hazardous waste shall be closed at all times during accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste, or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As a condition for exemption for satellite accumulation under rule 3745-52-15(A).
unit_attributes.statement: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation, a generator shall mark or label the generator's container with both the words "Hazardous Waste" and an indication of the hazards of the contents.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a generator accumulates acute hazardous waste or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the satellite accumulation amounts listed in paragraph (A) at or near any point of generation.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15 at or near any point of generation shall do either of the following within three consecutive calendar days: (a) comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or (b) remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area to either (i) a central accumulation area operated in accordance with the applicable requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, (ii) an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility, or (iii) an off-site designated facility.

unit_attributes.scope_text: During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period following excess accumulation under paragraph (A)(6) of rule 3745-52-15.
unit_attributes.statement: During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period when excess hazardous waste is accumulated, the generator shall continue to comply with paragraphs (A)(1) to (A)(5) of rule 3745-52-15.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When excess hazardous waste is accumulated beyond the satellite accumulation amounts under paragraph (A)(6) of rule 3745-52-15.
unit_attributes.statement: The generator shall mark or label the containers holding the excess accumulation of hazardous waste with the date the excess amount began accumulating.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator.
unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator shall meet the preparedness and prevention requirements of paragraph (B)(8) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code and emergency procedures of paragraph (B)(9) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator.
unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator shall meet the preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures in rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265 of the Administrative Code.

For dates of non-regulatory government publications, publications of recognized organizations and associations, federal rules, and federal statutory provisions referenced in rule 3745-52-15, see rule 3745-50-11 of the Administrative Code titled "Incorporated by reference."
